summary: Token-based authentication lets external applications such as ServiceNow and Jenkins integrate with AAP using OAuth 2 tokens, which can be read-only; a custom external application URL in the platform UI navigation is a Technology Preview. Controller OAuth applications are not supported for 2.4 to 2.5 migration.
questions: How do I integrate ServiceNow or Jenkins with AAP using tokens?
Can I add an external application link to the AAP navigation panel?
Are controller OAuth applications migrated from 2.4 to 2.5?
Can OAuth tokens be read-only in AAP?
